headline: Help in your community.
introduction: Volunteer with the county committee, attend a local event, or lend a hand to a Republican candidate in Hancock County.

opportunities.title: Host or attend an event
opportunities.description: Welcome neighbors, help with setup, or provide a space for a local gathering.

opportunities.title: Support a candidate
opportunities.description: Help with signs, literature, calls, outreach, or another campaign need.

opportunities.title: Share your skills
opportunities.description: Photography, writing, logistics, technology, and many other skills are valuable.
